## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are experiencing.
Ex. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you would like to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

A description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered and why they were not suitable.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, mockups, or references about the feature request here.

- Component(s) affected: [backend / ml-engine / frontend / infrastructure]
- Related issues or PRs: #...
